en-GB.summary: Manage your Family Hub shopping list with Alexa
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Family Hub add milk
Alexa, ask Family Hub what's on the shopping list
Alexa, tell Family Hub remove bread
en-GB.name: Family Hub
en-GB.description: Add, remove, and read items from your Family Hub shopping list using voice commands through your Amazon Echo or Dot devices.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: This is a private skill for the Brown family. Use with a Family Hub API key.
